inputs.description: an iterable of tensors to add.

destination.description: a device on which the output will be placed (default: current device).
constraints: destination must be an valid integer representing a device

output.description: A tensor containing an elementwise sum of all inputs, placed on the :attr:`destination` device.

constraints: All inputs should have matching shapes, dtype, and layout.
The output tensor will be of the same shape, dtype, and layout.
